name: hesperus
description: A map of what a repo reaches outside itself (databases, network, models, files, processes), linted against your policy, built by static analysis.
long_description: Hesperus compiles a repo's source into a graph of packages, files, types and functions, with the calls between them, and files every call that leaves the repo under what it reaches: databases, the network, AI models, cloud services, queues, the filesystem, processes and the environment. Ask it what talks to the database, what changed since you last reviewed, or who calls a function; show the boundary map as an interactive graph; lint crossings against a `hesperus.json` policy. Analysis only, on your machine: no model draws the edges and nothing is sent anywhere.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The repo to map. Other repos can still be named by path in each request.

tools.name: hesperus_index
tools.description: Rebuild the repo's graph from source.

tools.name: hesperus_check
tools.description: Lint boundary crossings against the policy and the accepted baseline.

tools.name: hesperus_diff
tools.description: Crossings and dependencies added or removed since the last accepted review.

tools.name: hesperus_boundaries
tools.description: Every call that leaves the repo, by boundary and package, with file:line.

tools.name: hesperus_calls
tools.description: Callers and callees of a function or type.

tools.name: hesperus_map
